prompt: Many people work for long hours, leaving them very little time for leisure. Does this situation have more advantages or disadvantages?
essay:
Working for a long period of time in a day with an extremely small amount of spare time for leisure activities can be advantageous when the main priority is to reach financial freedom. However, I believe that, in turn, there are implications in terms of individuals' overall well-being.

Admittedly, it has been believed by many that the more people work, the more they will be able to earn.  This is largely because there are certain sorts of jobs that allow employees to work by the hour. Some people with such jobs may take advantage by working for long hours, sometimes even more than a fixed schedule. In particular, when they are financially motivated, or they simply need to support themselves financially. These kinds of reasons may result in working for longer hours, since this might somehow tackle their issues related to money. For example, individuals who work as teachers could work more by teaching more numbers og classes in a day, meeting their financial needs, as they are often paid by the hour. People working in specific types of jobs may be allowed to work more than needed if they have financial responsibilities.

Even though employees work hard, taking on additional tasks, it may eventually result in having far less time for leisure. This can simply mean that people may experience fatigue without having sufficient time to get enough rest, which can ultimately lead to even higher levels of stress and anxiety. For instance, construction workers who regularly work long hours may have little opportunity to rest after physically demanding shifts, which can leave them exhausted and under considerable stress. As important as money is for people who are in need, health should come first, since being physically and mentally exhausted can make it considerably more difficult to perform their work effectively.

In conclusion, I strongly believe that although working long hours can provide people with a higher income, the negative effects on their physical and mental health are more significant.
